item.description: - Send Shelf files to another Mac with short codes. Transfers are encrypted, direct when possible with encrypted relay fallback, and only after recipient approval. - Use a code with 3 letters and 4 digits; add a fifth digit only after all 175,760,000 shorter codes are assigned. Lowercase and legacy identifiers remain accepted. - Capture screen text with optional on-device OCR, combine selections from several areas, and review or correct text before copying. QR codes and links offer explicit choices. - Add Internet Sharing auto-off choices and reorganize Settings for easier access to privacy, sync, updates, and app information.
